items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: I like Bunk Johnson. I like Big Spider-Bank. I like King Oliver. So what I do is try to combine all that three styles together

ctx.x: LPs. You see, uh, well, like I said before, uh, I like Bunk Johnson. I like Big Spider-Bank. I like King Oliver. So what I do is try to combine all that three styles together and maybe I'll come up with one of my own, who knows.
I like to play their stuff, you know. Any other trumpet players you can think of from your records?
